item.title: The litter on the side of the shocking. I have never seen it so bad. When is the road being cleaned next ?, 12th November
item.description:
Lots of litter alongside the M11 from junction 4 (Woodford) to the M25. It certainly is not 'predominantly free of liteer' as your strategy says. It is especially bad near Jct 5 (Loughton). It has been there for months and is causing environmental damage. And is a lot worse than most other motorways. I thought you were supposed to clear litter regularly ? When is this scheduled for ? Why are there no signs or cameras to discourage littering as there are on the M25 ? Or develop a campaign so people realise the cost and disruption linked to clearing litter.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): M11, Chigwell, Epping Forest
Report on FixMyStreet
